text:
june: quick question — we're planning a default-model change next week. do pinned clients stay pinned automatically or get switched to the new default?
sam: pinned clients are explicit. we don't mutate pins on default changes. only unpinned requests follow the default selection.
maria: +1. ops: if we need an emergency swap, we have a fallback route that maps unpinned -> legacy for 48h.
raf: can we document the header behavior? client SDKs need to know how to request an older model.
sam: yes — use header `X-Model-Version: v1.3` or `X-Model-Pin: true` for long-lived pins. new header names are in the spec: https://internal.redwood.dev/api/headers (shortlink).
zara: are we deprecating v1.3 entirely or just removing it from default rotation? timeline? :hourglass_flowing_sand:
sam: plan is: 30d notice for default removal, 90d deprecation window for unpinned traffic, 180d for final pin sunset. emergency exceptions possible with leadership signoff.
june: ok — for compatibility tests, do we have an automated eval that checks output diffs for pinned vs default? i don't want silent regressions.
maria: we do. CI job `contracts/e2e-pin-compat` runs a golden-check on a 200-sample prompt set, tolerances per-model in the eval config. it fails the deploy if top-level similarity drops > 5% or exact-match for structured responses changes.
raf: what about response shape changes (removed fields)? need to ensure clients don't break on optional nullable fields.
sam: breaking schema changes must go through the API contract playbook. short summary: major schema changes require a coordinator, a migration plan, a rollout with `X-Compat-Version` negotiation header and a 60-day opt-in period before enforcement.
zara: can we surface the `deprecation:date` in `/models` catalog so clients can programmatically decide?
maria: good idea. i'll open a tiny PR to add `deprecated_at` and `sunset_at` ISO timestamps to the catalog response.
deploy-bot: deploy queued: api-catalog:update-deprecation-fields #342 by maria — 1 staged check — ETA 18m
june: FYI: i'll add a note to the release notes and ping SDK teams to include the header knobs in next patch. small ask: add an example in the quickstart for explicit pinning.
sam: also ensure the telemetry emits `pin_status` on requests (pinned/unpinned/defaulted) — ops needs that to measure migration.
raf: can we get a short-runbook for rollback if default causes regression? what signals should trigger rollback?
maria: agree. suggested triggers: >3% latency regression across p95, >2% QA eval drift on golden set, or error-rate bump >0.5% absolute. we'll put that in the rollback doc.
zara: thanks — timeline sync: if catalog PR merges today, we can flip default on Mon, notice window starts Tue, and deprecation mails go out Wed. good?
june: sounds good. i'll coordinate the SDK pings and the release note snippet.
sam: i'll draft the deprecation email and the rollback playbook, then share for review.
raf: please cc platform-eng and support on the mail.
maria: PR link: https://git.internal.redwood/repo/PR/342 — comments welcome.
 j: thanks everyone, closing the loop — will follow up once catalog is live :white_check_mark:
